clips.title: The story
paras: Teronis' Journal follows a scout's search through Ashenvale for a gem tied to a rod he hoped could slow furbolg attacks.

Teronis, a longtime friend of Raene Wolfrunner, aided the Sentinels and searched Ashenvale for a gem. He believed it belonged to a rod that could slow the furbolg attacks on his people. Near the shore, aggressive creatures brought his journey to an end. The journal was recovered from his personal effects in remarkably good condition. Its findings about a radiant gem that once formed part of the rod give Astranaar's defenders a trail to follow in his unfinished search.
